result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the status bar, header, search, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The only visible concern is low-contrast light gray secondary text. The clipped chips, carousel items, and bottom card were excluded as intentional scroll affordances.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the rating count '(500+)', and the 'DELIVER TO' label is a light gray on white and may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text (roughly #6B6B6B or darker on white) to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
